description: LLM chat completion on larger models, flat $0.01 a call: prompt (plus optional system) or an OpenAI-style messages array in, reply text and token usage out. Models: gpt-oss-120b (default), deepseek-v4.1-flash, llama-3.3-70b, mistral-small-3.1, glm-5.3-flash. Up to 32,000 characters in and 2,048 tokens out; json=true for JSON output. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

json.description: true asks for a single JSON object

max_tokens.description: Most tokens to generate, up to 2048

prompt.description: The user message (or send an OpenAI-style messages array instead)
